Ps1.title: Communication Defined
Ps1.content:
What is Communication?

The word communication has been derived from the Latin word 'communis' that means 'common'. Communication incorporates, besides commonality, the concepts of transfer, meaning and information.

Notable Definitions

Communication can be defined as the process through which two or more persons come to exchange ideas and understanding among them.

Ps2.title: Effective Communication Skills: The 7 C's
Ps2.content:
Objectives of Communication

The objective of communication may be defined as the passing of ideas and understanding from the sender to the target with the view to getting the desired behavioral response from the latter.

The 7 C's of Communication

  • Completeness: Ensuring all relevant information has been sent after analyzing the receiver's mindset.
  • Conciseness: The use of accurate information in short sentences.
  • Consideration: Giving due attention to the advantage, needs, and thoughts of the receiver.
  • Concreteness: Interacting with preciseness or by referring to statistics.
  • Clarity: Expressing the purpose using simple, precise, and easy words.
  • Courtesy: Using polite words and understanding the mentality and feelings of receivers.
  • Correctness: Ensuring the factual accuracy of words used in verbal and non-verbal communication.
